# Sam's News — anthropic — 2026-10-05

## Expansion

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7.5/10" aria-label="Importance 7.5 of 10">7.5</span> Anthropic Launches Claude In-Country Inference in India via AWS Bedrock
Anthropic launched Claude in-country inference in India through Amazon Bedrock on October 5, enabling local data processing on Indian servers. The three available models address data residency requirements for Indian banks, insurers, government bodies, and regulated enterprises operating under strict regulatory obligations.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Three Claude models available: Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5</li>
<li>Data processed on servers located within India, meeting residency requirements</li>
<li>Targets Indian banks, insurers, government, and large regulated enterprises</li>
<li>Anthropic considers India one of its largest markets with strong developer community</li>
<li>Long-term investment announced in August 2026</li>
</ul>
